adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` plus an `if (!tokenResponse.success) console.error(..., responseJson)` block with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) throws on `!success`, so the subsequent spread `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` becomes effectively dead code (it will only execute when `success` is true). The prior logging of the Microsoft response on invalid tokens is removed, so failures will no longer log the provider response (instead they throw). This is a real, diff-grounded observability/debuggability regression, but not a clearly verifiable correctness defect by itself.
